summary: Today presents a mixed legal and corporate briefing driven by judicial and regulatory directives in Karnataka alongside retail market growth. Key highlights cover court orders on transport policy, recruitment fraud, domestic retail expansion, and strategic telecom moves.

bullets.text: The Karnataka High Court ordered an FIR into the KPSC recruitment scam following shocking revelations submitted by the Enforcement Directorate.
Karnataka Transport Minister Byrathi Suresh announced plans to frame bike taxi regulations after consulting the Advocate General following a Supreme Court direction.
India now contributes 20% to U.S. Polo Assn.’s total global revenue as the apparel brand expands its footprint across the country.
India is set for a record wedding economy boom estimated to reach Rs 7.5 lakh crore during the upcoming season.
Reliance is exploring satellite manufacturing partnerships to build domestic capacity and challenge Starlink's entry into the Indian market.
